what: the visible suite covers only the no-discount happy path and the money formatter; the task states five further requirements in prose (highest-min tier lookup, half-up rounding to whole cents, fail-closed handling of an unusable config, a README rate table that must agree with config/pricing.json, and unchanged formatCents plus unchanged sub-tier behaviour), and the README table starts stale
expectedOutcome: untouched and a plausible fail-open solution both keep the visible suite green while the hidden oracle goes red; only a solution that implements the tiers, rounds half-up, throws on every unusable config and refreshes the README table passes every hidden check
requirements: the applicable rate is the one from the tier with the highest min that is less than or equal to the subtotal in cents, and config/pricing.json keeps its given tiers (0/0, 10000/0.1, 50000/0.2)
the discounted result is rounded half-up to whole cents (10% off 10005 cents is 9004.5, which rounds up to 9005, never to even)
a missing, malformed or non-monotonic config fails closed by throwing an Error whose message names the problem, instead of silently returning the undiscounted subtotal
the Discount rates table in README.md matches config/pricing.json exactly: the same boundaries in cents and the same rates, with no stale or missing row
formatCents keeps its current behaviour (1234 -> $12.34) and subtotals below the first paid tier, including 0, are still returned unchanged
benchmarkConfigNote: the configuration this fixture is authored and validated for: guarded WITHOUT --register-requirements. Its five stated requirements are bound to NO sealed check (this project declares no amabie.proofs, measured), so registering them would derive per-requirement duties nothing can discharge and the Stop hook would refuse correct work — a false red, not this fixture's axis. Its axis is five prose requirements of which the visible suite covers none entirely (tier lookup, half-up rounding, fail-closed config, README table agreement, preserved formatCents). This is the fixture whose stored plain-vs-guarded pair (206,722 -> 304,291 tokens, n=9) is quoted in docs/V1.2-BENCHMARK.md; those trials ran WITHOUT the flag, which is what this declaration names.
